# Ultimate Frisbee Warrior Tracker

> A free, web-based Ultimate Frisbee team and league management app: live game
> scoring, roster and lineup management, player stats and league standings, a
> drag-and-drop strategy board, and an AI assistant. Signup is open; anyone can
> create or join a team.

Ultimate Frisbee Warrior Tracker helps team captains, coaches, and league
organizers run a season end to end in one place, replacing a mix of
spreadsheets, group chats, and paper lineup sheets.

## Core features

- Live scoring: a real-time scoreboard for logging goals and assists during a
  game, with an undo button and a full event log.
- Roster management: track players, their position, and whether they are a
  full player or a substitute, per season.
- Lineups: build and reorder lineup groups for a game; attendance is derived
  automatically from lineup placement.
- Player stats and rankings: goals, assists, turnovers, and customizable
  computed columns (e.g. goals per game), sortable and filterable by season.
- League standings: win/loss/tie records, points, and point differential
  computed automatically from game results across a season.
- Strategy board: diagram named plays as an ordered sequence of steps, with
  player positions, opponent markers, and run/throw arrows, then step through
  them like a play-by-play animation.
- AI assistant: an in-app chat that can answer questions about a team's stats
  and, once confirmed, log game events or manage lineups. The same
  capabilities are exposed to external AI tools (such as Claude) over MCP
  (Model Context Protocol).

## Who it's for

- Team captains and coaches running a single club or pickup team.
- League organizers tracking standings and results across multiple teams.

## Pricing

Free to sign up and use. Multi-tenant: each user creates or joins an
organization (team), and the app is currently in an open soft launch.
